insights.claim: batch-gateway delegates all authentication to an external platform gateway and passes the Authorization header through to downstream llm-d inference endpoints without validation.
insights.reasoning: The middleware chain (Recovery, RequestMiddleware, SecurityHeaders) contains no authentication filter. The Authorization header is listed in passThroughHeaders for batch API, meaning it is forwarded to downstream inference calls without local validation. This design requires a platform-level gateway (such as the llm-d-inference-gateway referenced in HTTPRoute config) to enforce authentication before requests reach the batch-gateway.

insights.claim: All three batch-gateway Konflux Dockerfiles consistently apply GOEXPERIMENT=strictfipsruntime with CGO_ENABLED=1 on UBI9, providing uniform FIPS-validated cryptography across all binaries.
insights.reasoning: All three Konflux Dockerfiles use identical build patterns: CGO_ENABLED=1, GOEXPERIMENT=strictfipsruntime, and UBI9 base images. The internal/tls package uses only stdlib crypto/tls, which under strictfipsruntime routes through OpenSSL for FIPS-validated operations. No non-FIPS crypto libraries were detected.
